title: The 37-Star and the 37-Hexagon on their own
summary: The two 37-point shapes taken out of the 73-Star: a gold six-pointed star outline holding 37 small gold Stars of David ('37-Star') and a red hexagon outline holding 37 small red Stars of David ('37-Hexagon').

numbers.note: points in the star figure and in the hexagon figure

pictures.description: A gold six-pointed star outline filled with 37 small gold Stars of David in rows, labelled '37-Star'.
A red hexagon outline filled with 37 small red Stars of David in rows (4, 5, 6, 7, 6, 5, 4), labelled '37-Hexagon'.
